Emma Raducanu reached the final of the Queen's Club tournament, marking a significant return to form. The analysis focuses on her tactical adjustments and the impact of rehiring her former coach, Andrew Richardson, ahead of Wimbledon.

Her ability to integrate coaching feedback mid-match and maintain a 'free' playing style suggests she is moving past the pressure of her 2021 success.

Raducanu's trajectory is structurally sound. By re-engaging a coach who understands her baseline, she has successfully reduced the noise in her performance, allowing her natural game to re-emerge with clarity.

It is wonderful to see Emma finding her joy on the court again. The sting of a final loss is real, but the resilience she showed this week is a beautiful testament to her hard work and love for the game.
